subject: StratusBridge / Redwood: co-sell demo coordination and slot finalization
messages:
From: Elaine Park <elaine@stratusbridge.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>; Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Morgan Liu <morgan.liu@stratusbridge.com>
Date: Tue, 11 Sep 2028 14:03:00 -0700
Subject: StratusBridge x Redwood — demo slot request

Hi Irene / Marissa,

Thanks again for the call yesterday. StratusBridge is excited to co-present with Redwood for our joint customer proof-of-concept next week. AWS SE has asked to join and prefers an earlier window for their SE to run a short architectural pre-brief.

Can we do one of the following windows next week (PT)?
- Wed 9/13 10:00–11:00
- Thu 9/14 08:00–09:00 (AWS prefers earlier)

High-level agenda attached (draft): 10–15m exec overview, 25–30m technical deep-dive, 10–15m Q&A + next steps. We can split into two sessions if that helps people join for only the parts they need.

Attachments: co-sell-agenda.gdoc (link stub), questions list (docx)

Thanks —
Elaine Park
Director, Partnerships | StratusBridge
elaine@stratusbridge.com
From: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>
To: Elaine Park <elaine@stratusbridge.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, AWS SE Team <aws-se@amazon.com>
Date: Tue, 11 Sep 2028 16:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: StratusBridge x Redwood — demo slot request

Hi Elaine — really appreciate the heads-up. Wed 9/13 10:00–11:00 PT works for our execs and product, but our backend engineering lead is on focus time until 11:30 PT. If AWS needs to run a short pre-brief that includes our infra lead, we may need to shift start earlier or split the call.

Options from our side:
- Keep Wed 9/13 10–11 but schedule an AWS + infra 9:30–9:50 PT separate call (we can do a 20m pre-brief)
- Move to Wed 9/13 09:00–10:00 PT (tight for Pacific attendees)
- Split the session: 09:30–10:00 technical pre-brief (AWS + infra), 10:00–10:40 main demo, 10:40–11:00 Q&A/next steps

Marissa / Vanessa / Karthik — can you weigh in on engineering and sales/CS availability for the split option? If we go with two contiguous windows it's easier for the customer to join one invite with clear calendar blocks.

Thanks,
Irene Choi
Head of Partner GTM | Redwood Inference
irene@redwood.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Elaine Park <elaine@stratusbridge.com>
Date: Wed, 12 Sep 2028 09:35:00 -0700
Subject: Re: StratusBridge x Redwood — demo slot request

Irene — quick note: our platform engineer (Anil) is in APAC hours that day and can only do an early morning PT slot (before 9am). The rest of product/solutions can move. If we split, Anil can join a 08:50–09:10 tech pre-brief, but he won't be available at 09:30.

If AWS absolutely needs to hit the infra questions live with Anil, we should either:
- Do the pre-brief 08:50–09:10 PT, keep the main demo at 10–11 (so Anil only attends the small pre-brief), or
- Move the whole program earlier (which may be rough for some east-coast execs).

I can book Anil for 08:50–09:10 if that helps.

-Marissa
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>, Elaine Park <elaine@stratusbridge.com>, AWS SE Team <aws-se@amazon.com>
Date: Wed, 12 Sep 2028 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: StratusBridge x Redwood — demo slot request

Thanks team — propose we make this two linked calendar events to reduce churn for attendees:
1) 08:50–09:10 PT — technical pre-brief (invite only: AWS SE, Anil, Marissa, Karthik)
2) 10:00–11:00 PT — joint exec + product demo (invite: all stakeholders)

We'll mark the first as optional on the main invite but send a separate short invite for the pre-brief so it doesn't clutter calendars. Vanessa, can you draft the two invites and include the runbook? I'll loop in the product deck and the infra notes.

-delegate to Vanessa for invites
Karthik Iyer
Head Solutions | Redwood Inference
From: Elaine Park <elaine@stratusbridge.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Cc: Morgan Liu <morgan.liu@stratusbridge.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 12 Sep 2028 13:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: StratusBridge x Redwood — demo slot request

Appreciate the flexibility. The two-event plan works for StratusBridge and AWS — Morgan will join the pre-brief with your infra lead. Please confirm calendar invites and we can finalize the agenda. We'll want the runbook and any ask list 24 hours in advance.

Elaine
From: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>
To: Elaine Park <elaine@stratusbridge.com>, Morgan Liu <morgan.liu@stratusbridge.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, AWS SE Team <aws-se@amazon.com>
Date: Thu, 13 Sep 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: StratusBridge x Redwood — demo slot request

All — confirmed and calendar invites sent:
- Technical pre-brief: 2028-09-13 08:50–09:10 PT (invite: Marissa, Anil (infra), Karthik, Morgan, AWS SE)
- Joint demo: 2028-09-13 10:00–11:00 PT (invite: execs, product, sales, StratusBridge)

Attachments included in the invite: Redwood-demo-runbook-v2.pdf (runbook with timeboxes), co-sell-agenda.gdoc (link). I'll include a short bullet list of asks in the invite description:
- AWS: infra constraints and S3/networking notes
- StratusBridge: customer success intro + desired outcomes
- Redwood: demo flow + follow-up PoC steps and cost profile

Doc links and calendar: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=redwood-stratusbridge-demo-20280913

If anything changes, flag in thread and Vanessa will update calendar. Thanks everyone for the quick turnaround.

Best,
Irene Choi
Head of Partner GTM | Redwood Inference
irene@redwood.com
